listings.name: Mediclinic Kloof
listings.current_description: Mediclinic Kloof is a multidisciplinary private hospital in Erasmuskloof offering a broad spectrum of professional medical services, including a 24-hour Emergency Centre, and serves private and medical aid patients in Pretoria East close to the N1.

listings.name: Medilase
listings.current_description: Medilase is a laser and light-based technology provider on the CSIR campus in Brummeria, offering pain-free laser hair removal, vascular and pigmentation treatments and surgical laser procedures, and distributing ELLEX vision-care laser and ultrasound ophthalmology systems.

listings.name: Meljoux Accounting
listings.current_description: Meljoux Accounting is a Pretoria-based accounting practice in Meyerspark offering bookkeeping, financial statement preparation, tax returns and small-business accounting services to companies, sole proprietorships, trusts, and non-profit organisations such as schools, religious bodies and sports clubs.

listings.name: Metallurgical and Manufacturing Services
listings.current_description: Metallurgical and Manufacturing Services (MMS) provides welding, machining, reverse engineering and refurbishment work from its Rooihuiskraal facility, supporting industries including petrochemical, power generation, mining, defence, plastics and water treatment, and holds over 110 qualified welding procedures.

listings.name: Mica Celtis Ridge
listings.current_description: Part of one of Africa's largest hardware groups, this Celtis Ridge Shopping Centre store stocks hardware, power tools, paint, garden and pool care, and building supplies from brands such as Bosch, Plascon, Dulux, Ryobi and Gardena.

listings.name: Micro Robotics
listings.current_description: A leading South African supplier of electronic and robotic components for the maker and prototyping market, operating as an official distributor for Arduino, Adafruit, Sparkfun, Pololu, DF Robot and Itead from its Highveld Techno Park store.

listings.name: Mijoy Print
listings.current_description: Mijoy Print, based in Midlands Office Park in Midstream Estate, brings 22 years of printing experience to graphic design, litho and digital printing, event stationery and bespoke corporate gifts, serving clients that include the mining industry.

listings.name: Mint Kulca - Pretoria Office
listings.current_description: Mint Kulca is a recruitment and hiring technology company that helps organisations define and identify top performers through job scorecards and behavioural and values benchmarks, powered by ATS-enabled hiring software, operating from Highveld Techno Park, Centurion.

listings.name: Mint logistics
listings.current_description: Mint Logistics, based in Montana Park, is a removals company offering suburb-to-suburb home and office furniture removals across Johannesburg, Pretoria, Cape Town, the Garden Route, Pietermaritzburg and Durban, and is registered and insured with goods-in-transit cover.

listings.name: Modiba Du Plessis Attorneys
listings.current_description: Modiba Du Plessis Attorneys is a law firm in Villieria, Pretoria, offering commercial law, civil litigation, family law and property law services, including mediation, personal injury claims and estates and trusts, for corporate and individual clients.

listings.name: Monitor Net: Security Company
listings.current_description: Monitor Net: Security Company, based in Hennopspark, Centurion, has operated since 1995 as a 24/7 monitoring centre, offering alarm monitoring, armed response, CCTV monitoring and home and business security support across Centurion, Brits and Pretoria.

listings.name: Mooiwater Pompe-Pumps/Mia Bros
listings.current_description: Mooiwater Pompe-Pumps/Mia Bros, in East Lynne, Pretoria, supplies and installs borehole pumps, pressure pumps and petrol-powered water pumps, along with booster pumps, water tanks and pipe fittings, and also trades as a second-hand general dealer.

listings.name: Moove Motion Fitness Club - Silverton
listings.current_description: Moove Motion Fitness Club Silverton is a gym on Pretoria Road in Silverton offering group fitness classes plus strength and cardio equipment, and is one of the clubs in the Discovery Vitality wellness network of gyms.

listings.name: Motherland Coffee Company - Mooikloof
listings.current_description: Motherland Coffee Company's Mooikloof branch is part of a chain built around sourcing its coffee from African coffee-producing co-operatives and smallholder farmers through fair trade, serving coffee alongside wraps, toasts and pastries for dine-in or takeaway.

listings.name: Mr Matlala guest house
listings.current_description: Mr Matlala guest house offers accommodation for business travellers and tourists in Jan Niemand Park, with wheelchair-accessible parking and easy access to landmarks such as the University of Pretoria, the Union Buildings and the Voortrekker Monument.

listings.name: MTN Store Wonderboom Junction
listings.current_description: The MTN Store at Wonderboom Junction sells a range of 5G smartphones, laptops and tablets from brands including Samsung, Apple, Huawei, vivo, Xiaomi, Honor, OPPO, Hisense and CAT, alongside mobile contracts, prepaid SIMs and data deals.

listings.name: Mugg & Bean Irene Village Mall
listings.current_description: Part of the Mugg & Bean chain operating since 1996, this Irene Village Mall branch offers a dog-friendly outdoor patio and wheelchair-accessible seating alongside its usual coffee and cafe-style menu, with both delivery and takeaway available.

listings.name: MZIBANI CONSULTING ENGINEERS (PTY) LTD
listings.current_description: Mzibani Consulting Engineers (Pty) Ltd is a full-service civil engineering firm founded in 2011, providing planning and design services for public and private infrastructure with expertise in water and sanitation, structural engineering and road pavement design.

listings.name: NAD Packaging - Boxes
listings.current_description: Established in 2006, this Rosslyn-based manufacturer produces corrugated boxes, ISPM15-certified wooden pallets and crates, and slip sheets in single- and double-wall corrugated options, delivered nationwide. It is a women-owned packaging business serving Akasia and surrounding areas.

listings.name: Nape Labour Law and HR Services
listings.current_description: Nape Labour Law and HR Services is run by a team of qualified labour specialists, attorneys and advocates who help employers across industries countrywide with labour litigation, industrial relations, HR management and other labour-law compliance matters.

listings.name: National Zoological Garden
listings.current_description: The National Zoological Garden, also known as Pretoria Zoo, is an 85-hectare zoo founded in 1899 with over 700 animal species and South Africa's largest inland marine aquarium, open daily from 09:00 to 17:30.

listings.name: Nceda Business Technologies
listings.current_description: Nceda Business Technologies is an ICT services company established in 2009, offering integrated electronic security (CCTV and access control), mobile fleet management, push-to-talk radio solutions, and website and mobile app development from its Lynnwood Glen offices.

listings.name: News Cafe
listings.current_description: News Cafe Hatfield is a cafe-bar and cocktail restaurant in Hatfield, Pretoria, the location where the News Cafe chain first opened in South Africa in 1995, serving breakfasts, burgers, platters and cocktails in a vibrant atmosphere.

listings.name: Nkoka
listings.current_description: Nkoka is a training academy in Wierdapark and the only centre in Africa accredited by the IPC to deliver electronics and broadcast engineering training on its behalf, offering distance-learning National Certificate programmes for full-time employed learners.

listings.name: OK Foods Laudium
listings.current_description: OK Foods Laudium is a full-service supermarket in Laudium Plaza featuring an in-house butchery, a bakery for fresh bread and pastries, and a fresh produce section, serving as a one-stop grocery shop for the Laudium community.

listings.name: OK Furniture Gezina
listings.current_description: OK Furniture Gezina is a furniture and appliance showroom in Gezina Galleries, part of the national OK Furniture chain, stocking bedroom and lounge suites, TVs and home appliances alongside a wall-to-wall carpet service and delivery options.

listings.name: On Target Business Solutions
listings.current_description: On Target Business Solutions works alongside its sister company, On Target Financial Solutions, with a team of experienced staff addressing corporate and personal financial needs from its offices on Rooiberg Street in The Willows, Pretoria East.

listings.name: ONLY GOD BUSINESS CENTRE
listings.current_description: Only God Business Centre is a computer and IT services centre in East Lynne, Pretoria, providing local residents with computer, printing and related business support services from early morning to late evening, seven days a week.

listings.name: PAS Attorneys Pretoria
listings.current_description: PAS Attorneys Pretoria, based in Riviera, specialises in Road Accident Fund claims for clients with life-changing personal injuries from motor vehicle accidents, with over 20 years of experience, free initial consultations and no upfront legal fees.

listings.name: Pattern Matched Technologies (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Pattern Matched Technologies is a software development company specialising in the intersection of the telecommunications and finance industries, with more than 16 years behind its work in mobile banking, remittance wallets, debit cards and value-added-services delivery.

listings.name: Pavecorp SA Pretoria
listings.current_description: Pavecorp SA Pretoria is a paving and asphalt specialist based in Erasmuskloof, offering SABS-approved brick paving backed by a 15-year warranty and having completed over 1,000 residential and commercial projects across Pretoria, Centurion and Midrand.

listings.name: PC Palace GO
listings.current_description: PC Palace GO in Irene offers computer repairs, software solutions and printer repairs, part of the PC Palace group established in 1992 and operating as an IT specialist in the Centurion area for over 30 years.

listings.name: PCE Accountants
listings.current_description: PCE Accountants, in Monument Park since 2015, is led by two SAIPA-registered accountants with over 42 years of combined experience, providing accounting, tax and consulting services to SMEs, sole proprietors, trusts, guesthouses, veterinary practices and non-profits.

listings.name: PDS CIVIL AND STRUCTURAL ENGINEERS
listings.current_description: PDS Civil and Structural Engineers, based in Lynnwood, designs structural elements such as raft foundations, concrete slabs, structural steel, bridges and reservoirs for residential, commercial, industrial and educational projects, including hospitals, retirement villages and multi-storey buildings.

listings.name: Penta Mahindra Montana
listings.current_description: Penta Mahindra Montana is a Mahindra new and used vehicle dealership in Montana Gardens, offering a full range of new Mahindra models and quality-approved used cars backed by an on-site service team using genuine Mahindra parts.

listings.name: PG glass
listings.current_description: PG Glass Menlyn, which serves the Newlands area of Pretoria, is part of South Africa's largest vehicle glass repair and replacement network, offering windscreen chip repairs, anti-smash-and-grab film, and fitment of new windscreens and vehicle glass.

listings.name: Picksmart
listings.current_description: Picksmart is a software development company founded in 2012 and based in Faerie Glen, Pretoria, building custom ERP and CRM systems, Android and iOS apps, and business intelligence and system integration solutions for South African businesses.

listings.name: Plastics R US
listings.current_description: Plastics R US has traded in Annlin West since 2011, stocking a wide range of plastic and glassware products including bakeware, storage containers, garden and cleaning supplies, and party accessories, with delivery and in-store pickup available.

listings.name: Pocket Business
listings.current_description: Pocket Business is a business consulting and digital marketing company headquartered in Centurion, helping small and medium enterprise owners grow their revenue through services such as social media management, SEO, website development and online store integration.

listings.name: Practicut / Cut To Size Boards Rosslyn
listings.current_description: Practicut (Cut To Size Boards Rosslyn) supplies and processes cut-to-size boards for built-in units, kitchens, and vanities, and manufactures custom flatpack furniture cut to customers' exact measurements, pre-drilled and supplied with hardware, from its Rosslyn premises.

listings.name: Premier FMCG - Pretoria Wheat Mill
listings.current_description: Premier FMCG - Pretoria Wheat Mill is one of Premier FMCG's wheat mills, part of a food-manufacturing group whose history dates back to 1824 and includes the Snowflake and Blue Ribbon flour brands, operating from Waltloo.

listings.name: Prestige Properties Moot
listings.current_description: Prestige Properties Moot is a real estate agency, part of the Quotum Real Estate group alongside XpressSale Auctioneers, servicing property owners across Rietondale, Riviera, Villieria, Gezina, Queenswood, Kilner Park, Wonderboom South and the wider Moot area.

listings.name: Procon Projects and Construction (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Procon Projects and Construction is a family-run building and maintenance company with more than 30 years in the industry, offering everything from plumbing, painting, drywalling and waterproofing to steelwork, leak detection, civil work and granite countertops.

listings.name: PS23 Manufacturing & Distribution (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: PS23 Manufacturing & Distribution is based in Derdepoort, Pretoria, where it manufactures and distributes lubricants, greases, oil and fuel additives, and industrial cleaners, including its PS23 Metal Treatment product used in automotive, industrial and mining applications.

listings.name: PSG Wealth and Insure Wolwespruit
listings.current_description: PSG Wealth and Insure Wolwespruit is a branch of PSG Financial Services located in Erasmuskloof, offering asset and wealth management alongside insurance advice as part of a national financial services group that has operated since 1998.

listings.name: PTA BOEDELS (PTY) LTD
listings.current_description: PTA Boedels (Pty) Ltd specializes in the administration of deceased estates in Magalieskruin, Pretoria, with around 30 years of experience in the field. The firm assists with executor appointments, estate finalization, will drafting, and estate planning.

listings.name: Rapid Rentals
listings.current_description: Rapid Rentals is an owner-assist real estate agency with more than 26 years' experience handling property sales, rentals and letting administration across northern Pretoria, and also runs Rapid Maintenance, a property repairs division, from Villieria, Pretoria.

listings.name: Rawson Properties Centurion
listings.current_description: Rawson Properties Centurion is a real estate office handling residential sales, including houses, apartments, townhouses and vacant land, across Centurion and the greater Johannesburg area, with a team of nine agents, serving Eldo Lakes Estate, Centurion.

listings.name: Rayetsa Furniture Pretoria
listings.current_description: Rayetsa Furniture Pretoria designs and manufactures bespoke custom furniture, also offering event furniture rental, re-upholstery and bulk business furniture supply, having completed more than 5,500 orders across South Africa and neighbouring countries, from Andeon, Pretoria.

listings.name: Reef Chainsaw Centre (Pretoria West)
listings.current_description: Reef Chainsaw Centre (Pretoria West) is an authorised Husqvarna dealer selling and repairing chainsaws, brush cutters, lawnmowers, ride-on mowers, polesaws, blowers and chippers, and offers free operator training; it also manufactures the locally-built TurfKing 750 mower.
